meta.name: dag-library
meta.description: Stores a DAG definition once and re-runs it by name, instead of pasting the definition into every run. Use when the user wants to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 保存一次多智能体任务流程，之后按名称即可重跑。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常要反复执行同一套智能体协作流程，希望保存一次就能按名重跑。
copy.tagline_en: Save once, then rerun multi-agent jobs by name.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you keep recreating the same multi-agent workflow and need a saved way to rerun it.

howto.what: 把你的多节点 DAG 定义存成 `<name>.json` 放进库目录,之后按名字重复运行,不用每次重新粘贴定义。加载时会自动轮换 key,默认每次都是一次全新运行。
howto.when: 当你要求保存 DAG、运行已保存的 DAG,或重复调度同一套多 Agent 图时触发。它只管「存储与重跑」这半边;全新编写图要先看 mass-ulw。

say.text: 把当前这张 DAG 保存成 nightly-audit

say.note: key 自动加 UTC 时间戳后缀,开始一次全新运行
同后缀复用旧运行(幂等恢复)

howto.what_en: Saves your multi-node DAG as <name>.json in the library dirs and re-runs it by name, so you stop pasting the definition each time. Loading rotates the key, so the default is a fresh run per call.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to save a DAG, run a saved one, or schedule the same multi-agent graph repeatedly. It covers storage and re-running only; authoring a new graph starts with mass-ulw.

say_en.text: Save the current DAG as nightly-audit

say_en.note: Key gets a UTC timestamp suffix, starting a fresh run
Same suffix reuses the old run (idempotent recovery)
